text: Underway in this round twelve encounter.
Tortoise calls out early, urging composure and taking responsibility for their own half.
Hare loses footing on the right and goes down.
Griezmatronn carries it forward nicely down the left touchline, looking to test Fable's defensive shape early on.
Tortoise is clean through here!
Driving forward through the right channel, plenty of space to exploit.
Tortoise right in front now!
And Tortoise finishes it! A tidy, direct run from their own third and AFC Fable take the lead, one nil!
Hare shouts across to claim the loose ball in the final third.
Tortoise takes an awkward tumble in the defensive third, needing a few seconds to right themselves.
Tortoise clatters into Griezmatronn here.
A narrow shave at close range!
Griezmatronn scrambles it home! Synthetic Athletic hit straight back, squaring it up at one apiece!
A hurried clearance nearly deflects back inside the post, but it skips harmlessly wide.
Another close shave in Fable's defensive third as Synthetic Athletic keep the pressure
Robodinho turns it in right at the mouth of goal! That is thirty-nine for the season, and Athletic have turned it around to lead two-one!
A clumsy mix-up between Hare and Tortoise, and Hare hits the turf in midfield.
Hare goes down again out wide, struggling to keep balance under pressure.
Hare shouts out that the near post is covered as the ball rolls dangerously close.
A rare quiet spell. Synthetic Athletic, one of the league's frozen originals, are relying on their live calls rather than any between-match tweaks, and it has served them well so far.
Fable pressing high, penning Athletic back.
The corner ram fires it back into the mix.
Hare calls loudly to claim the rebound, warning against any lapse in concentration.
Griezmatronn bursts completely clear on the right!
And rolls it into an empty net. Efficient work from Griezmatronn, making it three-one to Synthetic Athletic.
Hare pulls one back just before the break! Right on the doorstep, and Fable are within one at two-three!
Tortoise communicates cleanly, tracking back to plug the space behind.

Power off at the buzzer, ball still live, but it settles without drama. Fable with an unchanged squad today, trailing three-two at the interval.
Griezmatronn slots another home from two yards out to restore Athletic's two-goal cushion. Four-two.
Just wide of the upright.
Robodinho snatches it right off the line, poking home their second of the match. Five-two to Synthetic Athletic.
Ram panel boots it clear.
Tortoise is through, completely unmarked.
Tortoise shouts to signal the ball's trajectory towards the Athletic net.
Tortoise rumbles steadily across the centre circle, dragging the magenta ball into the middle.
Tortoise scuffs the finish inches wide of the left post.
The push-panel launches the ball out of the corner, keeping the tempo rolling along.
Griezmatronn takes a misstep and folds in midfield, but the actuators are already whirring to reset.
Tortoise pokes it in from two metres. Fable pull one back, three-five.
Fable applying heavy pressure here.
Hare barks encouragement, demanding sharpness to see this spell through.
A close call at the back, scraping just past the post with time ticking away.
Hare is completely clear through the right channel with two minutes left!
Hare powers on down the channel, desperate to carve out an angle.
Just clips wide of the upright, but Fable are pouring forward now.

Fable are swarming the final third, pinning Athletic firmly against the back wall.
Hare calls out that they have the loose ball out wide, racing to keep the attack alive.
Hare breaks clean through on goal in the final minute!
Hare drives to point-blank range!
Hare levels it! What a comeback! Five-five with barely fifty seconds to play!
Hare drives into the box again!
Hare has scored again! Unbelievable! Four straight goals for Fable and they lead six-five in the final seconds!
